title: Pipeline (tasks)
description: The task queue (ADR 0014, 0030): what is open, what is failing, and why.

list.name: source
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM core.source ORDER BY name

panels.title: Open tasks
panels.description: Queued, running or waiting for a retry

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Open" FROM ops.task WHERE state IN ('queued', 'running', 'failed') AND source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring})

panels.title: Retrying
panels.description: Failed attempts waiting for their backoff (state failed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Retrying" FROM ops.task WHERE state = 'failed' AND source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring})

panels.title: Dead tasks
panels.description: Out of attempts and not yet requeued: each needs a human (listed below)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Dead" FROM ops.task t WHERE t.state = 'dead' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.task r WHERE r.retry_of = t.id) AND t.source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring})

panels.title: Stuck leases
panels.description: Running longer than the 10-minute lease; the scheduler's reaper should clear these

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Stuck" FROM ops.task WHERE state = 'running' AND locked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes' AND source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring})

panels.title: Tasks per hour by outcome
panels.description: From ops.pipeline_run, by hour the task was created

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, sum(done) AS "Done", sum(failed) AS "Retrying", sum(dead) AS "Dead" FROM ops.pipeline_run WHERE source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Finished tasks per hour by kind

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, kind AS metric, sum(done) AS value FROM ops.pipeline_run WHERE source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY hour, kind ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Failing and dead tasks
panels.description: Retrying tasks and dead tasks awaiting review, with the last error (newest first). After review: aoi task requeue <Task>

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.updated_at AS "When", t.id AS "Task", s.name AS "Source", t.kind AS "Kind", t.state AS "State", t.attempts AS "Attempts", t.run_after AS "Next attempt", t.last_error AS "Last error" FROM ops.task t JOIN core.source s ON s.id = t.source_id WHERE (t.state = 'failed' OR (t.state = 'dead' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.task r WHERE r.retry_of = t.id))) AND t.source_id::text IN (${source:sqlstring}) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
